title: The Brunies family and a note from Gussie Mueller
summary: Photos of the many Brunies brothers, a doubtful Harry Shields identification, and a note from Gussie Mueller saying he got his first break with Laine.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Who's that? He looks familiar. Mary Brunus. Oh, that's Mary.
Mary Brunus, Denise, Abby Brunus, Georgie Brunus.
It looks like they got a bottle of muscatel. That Harry Shields?

Yeah. No, no, she ain't there. No, no, that's Joe Moranison. Looks like Joe Moranison. Looks like Joe Moranison. I can't see so well. I know Head Brunus was in that bunch, I believe, the day they came in.
How many Brunus were there anyway?
Oh, say there was a fleet of them. Yeah. There was a fleet of them. You know who this is, don't you?

Oh, yes, I know that one. Mm-hmm. That's a nice message that Gussie Mueller wrote you on. I'm copying it down because that's written proof, you know? Mm-hmm. When he says that he's one of the many New Orleans boys who got their first break with you. Yeah. It's a nice thing of him to say.
Yeah, that's when Georgia comes down here, you know?
